message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Continuous Integration

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, reopened, synchronize]
  push:
    branches:
      - master
jobs:
  Test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    name: OTP ${{matrix.versions.otp}} / Elixir ${{matrix.versions.elixir}}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        versions:
          - elixir: "1.16"
            otp: "26"
          - elixir: "1.17"
            otp: "27"
          - elixir: "1.18"
            otp: "27"
          - elixir: "1.18"
            otp: "28"
          - elixir: "1.19"
            otp: "28"
          - elixir: "1.19"
            otp: "29"
          - elixir: "1.20"
            otp: "29"
    env:
      MIX_ENV: test
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: |
            deps
            _build
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-otp-${{ matrix.versions.otp }}-elixir-${{ matrix.versions.elixir }}-mix-${{ hashFiles('**/mix.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-otp-${{ matrix.versions.otp }}-elixir-${{ matrix.versions.elixir }}-mix-

      - name: Set up Elixir
        uses: erlef/setup-beam@v1
        with:
          otp-version: ${{matrix.versions.otp}}
          elixir-version: ${{matrix.versions.elixir}}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          mix deps.get

      - name: Run Tests
        run: mix test

  Linting:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    name: Linting
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Set up Elixir
        uses: erlef/setup-beam@v1
        with:
          elixir-version: "1.16"
          otp-version: "26"

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          mix local.rebar --force
          mix local.hex --force
          mix deps.get

      - name: Run Formatter
        run: mix format --check-formatted

      - name: Run Credo
        run: mix credo",
  "rationale": "Add an explicit per-job timeout (timeout-minutes: 5) to both the Test and Linting jobs to bound runaway consumption without changing any build/test step or coverage. The repository's CI history shows successful runs completing in roughly one minute, so a five-minute budget gives ample headroom for cold dependency installation, and the pattern's contraindication (valid slow runs exceeding the limit) is not indicated. This matches the measured P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT experiment (batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) that added timeout-minutes: 5 and reduced elapsed time, with related history-timeout cases also showing benefit.",
  "evidence_ids": ["P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]
}
